evidence.excerpt: The invention describes a process for producing a thermoplastic starch–plant protein composite by reactive co-extrusion in a co-rotating twin-screw extruder, wherein a near-infrared or ultrasonic sensor integrated into the barrel provides a continuous signal used to adjust barrel temperature set-points via a feedback loop, maintaining gelatinisation degree within ±5 percentage points of a target value. The process includes adding a dicarboxylic acid compatibiliser at 0.3–0.8 wt% relative to dry blend mass. The patent claims the process itself and the in-line control scheme; it does not claim the material composition. Filed with the Intellectual Property Office of the Republic of Serbia; PCT extension under evaluation.
